messages.content:
A reader of a contract claims that the quoted passages below settle a statement (the hypothesis). You do not see the contract; judge only from the quotes.

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.
</hypothesis>

<claimed_label>
Entailment
</claimed_label>

<quotes>
<quote>such person or entity will (i) promptly notify the Corporation of the existence, terms and circumstances surrounding such a request or requirement</quote>
<quote>is required by law, regulation, stock exchange or regulatory authority to disclose any Confidential Information</quote>
</quotes>

The labels mean:
- Entailment: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is false.

Decide whether the quotes, taken as written, are enough on their own to support the claimed label. Answer supports = false if the quotes are about something else, support the opposite label, support only part of the hypothesis, or need context the quotes do not give.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: supports (true or false) and a one-sentence reason.

content.text: {"supports":true,"reason":"The quotes together state that a person required by law or regulation to disclose Confidential Information must promptly notify the Corporation (the disclosing party) of the request, which matches the hypothesis's notification obligation."}
